title: AssetEntry
description: One entry of an Extension's `assets` list: a first-class AssetType. The type carries its own stable identity, identity hooks, source codec and factory provider, and is installed on the applications that list it and on no other - importing the module that defines it installs nothing.

sections.title: Import
paragraphs: One entry of an Extension's `assets` list: a first-class AssetType.
